subject: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC/trial plan - ACME Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@acmecorp.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.b@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC/trial plan - ACME Corp

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and helpful context on ACME's ingestion patterns and latency targets. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get a PoC on the calendar.

Recap of requirements you mentioned:
- Data class: user PII in a subset of call transcripts (we should confirm scope).
- Latency: median tail under ~300ms for short queries (95th < 700ms).
- Throughput: ~50 concurrent requests during business hours, burst to 200.
- Success criteria: model quality parity with in-house baseline on your eval set, stable <1.5x cost multiple vs. target, and no measurable data leakage.

Deployment options we discussed (summary):
- Hosted API: fastest to start, minimal integration time, but data routed through Redwood hosted endpoints (encrypted in transit + at rest).
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool for predictable throughput and tenant isolation — good middle ground for teams wanting performance + isolation without operating infra.
- Private VPC / on-prem: full network isolation, customer-managed networking & KMS; longer lead time (network + security review + onboarding).

Proposed PoC / trial plan (attached: redwood-poc-plan-acme-v1.pdf):
- Length: 3 weeks (option to extend).
- Week 0: Kickoff + access setup (choose deployment mode).
- Week 1-2: Ingest & run evaluation prompts, iterate on prompt engineering and model variant.
- Week 3: Measure against success criteria, present findings and cost projection.

Stakeholders / owners (please confirm):
- ACME technical lead: Samir (you) — data access and test dataset
- ACME product: Olivia — quality sign-off
- Redwood AE: Ben Carter — commercial / roadmap owner
- Redwood SE: Jordan Blake — PoC tech lead
- Redwood CSM: Marissa Cole — rollout & success planning

Actions / asks for ACME before kickoff:
1) Please confirm preferred deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC).
2) Share a short sample eval set (anonymized) or a description of the golden set access pattern.
3) Introduce the procurement contact if we need a purchase order or SOW to start Dedicated/Private timelines.
4) Any network/firewall restrictions we should know about if you prefer Dedicated or Private VPC.

I attached a PoC plan and our SOC2 summary (high-level) — happy to get you a more complete security packet if needed.

If we can lock deployment mode by Monday, I propose a technical kickoff Wednesday 14 April.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0150

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-acme-v1.pdf
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.b@acmecorp.com>
Cc: procurements@acmecorp.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC/trial plan - ACME Corp

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- We do process PII and regulated customer identifiers. Our legal team prefers Private VPC for anything that persists raw transcripts. That said, for an evaluation we could do a Dedicated environment if we scope the dataset to fully anonymized transcripts.
- Timeline: procurement will need ~3-4 weeks for Dedicated contracts; Private VPC will likely need infra work and a security review (6-8 weeks). Hosted API would be immediate but may not pass our compliance checks for production.
- Success criteria: in addition to your bullets, we need an offline reproducible evaluation script (so we can re-run benchmarks locally) and a simple metric report (precision/recall & latency distribution).
- SOC2: could you send the full SOC2 Type 2 report to our security mailbox? We need the control list for the security review.

If we proceed with a PoC now, my preference is:
1) Short PoC on Dedicated (anonymized dataset) to validate performance and cost.
2) Parallel work to scope Private VPC for production (security + network).

I've CC'd procurement; procurement@acmecorp.com will coordinate contracts.

Thanks —
Samir Khan
Head of Data Platform, ACME Corp
samir.k@acmecorp.com

Samir / Olivia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the procurement intro. Couple notes and updated next steps based on your preference to validate on Dedicated while scoping Private VPC for prod: 

1) Docs & compliance
- I've attached the SOC2 summary (SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf) and opened a secure folder with the full report for your security team (link above). If you provide the security mailbox, I'll share the full report via the secure link.

2) PoC plan update (short version)\- Option A (Dedicated trial): 3-week dedicated GPU pool with RBAC and tenant isolation. Expected lead time: procurement + account setup, ~2-3 weeks.
- Option B (Hosted quick-check): 1-2 day smoke test against anonymized subset to validate prompt/quality (no persistence). Immediate.
- Option C (Private VPC for prod): parallel security & network onboarding; estimated 6-8 week lead time from signed SOW.

3) Success criteria (confirmed):
- Quality: ACME eval set F1 >= baseline (we'll deliver a reproducible script).
- Latency: 95th < 700ms under PoC traffic pattern.
- Cost: projection <= 1.5x your target per-session cost (we'll provide a cost model).
- Security: SOC2 controls satisfied for Dedicated; Private VPC meets network/KMS requirements.

4) Proposed schedule
- Wed Apr 14: Technical kickoff (30-45m) — Jordan will lead. Please confirm earliest availability.
- Fri Apr 16: Dry run / Hosted smoke test (if you want to validate prompts immediately).
- PoC start: target Apr 25 for Dedicated pool (pending procurement).

5) Action items
- ACME: confirm whether you want us to start with Hosted smoke test this week (yes/no) and confirm technical lead for kickoff.
- Procurement: please review attached PoC SOW and send PO or redlines.
- Redwood: Jordan to send sample eval script and runbook; Marissa to own success tracking and post-PoC rollout plan.

Looping in Jordan and Marissa for scheduling and technical logistics.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0150

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf
